page.title: Proposal workspace and review
page.purpose: Author and review scoped artifact and graph changes, then inspect authorized owner-directed application.

priorities.statement: Make exact revision, target scope and material changes legible.
Keep authority, validation limitations and dependency holds visible.
Show applied, conflicted and partial outcomes with safe recovery.

Show relevant base conflicts and preserve independent edits.
Show per-entry progress and the durable operation identity.
Reconcile owner receipts before retrying an interrupted operation.
Explain retained reviewed content and deletion consequences.
Show explicit execution allowances, isolated inputs and evidence limitations.
